title: 1. Choose your Combat Style
description: Choose Bastion, Conduit, or an empty slot. Your selection applies to every battle, and each style keeps its own permanent level and XP.

title: 2. Read the core mechanic
description: See the effect of your current mastery. Every level adds a bonus, and level 7 grants an automatic Opening Technique. Conduit's Focus selector is here; choose an eligible Essence and keep it equipped in every loadout you use for battle.

title: 3. Refine your style
description: Choose a refinement at level 3, then different upgrades in the slots earned at levels 5 and 8. At level 9, empower one equipped upgrade with Upgrade Mastery. The base form remains a valid choice.

title: 4. Save your choices
description: Save applies the configuration to future battles. Discard restores your saved choices. A committed battle keeps its captured style and mastery until it ends.
